blocks.text: Central nervous system ki infections taqreeban har qisam ke jaraseem (infectious agents) se ho sakti hain, jin mein viruses, bacteria, fungi, protozoa aur flatworms shamil hain.

Meningitis infection ki wajah se meninges ki sozish (inflammation) hai. Wajahein: bacterial meningitis sab se shadeed aur jaan leva hai. Viral meningitis aam taur par kam shadeed hoti hai. Fungal meningitis kam hoti hai aur zyada tar kamzor immunity walon mein hoti hai. Doosri wajahon mein parasites ki infections shamil hain. Alamaat mein gardan ki akran (stiffness), sar dard aur bukhar shamil hain. Shadeed halat mein meningitis falij ya coma (gehri behoshi) bhi la sakti hai. Ilaj: bacterial meningitis ka fauran antibiotics se ilaj zaroori hai. Viral meningitis aam taur par khud theek ho jati hai (self-limiting), agarche antiviral dawayein bhi di ja sakti hain. Fungal meningitis ke liye lambe arse tak antifungal dawayein chahiye. Kuch bacterial meningitis ke liye vaccines maujood hain jo infection se bacha sakti hain.

blocks.prompt: Bacterial meningitis ka fauri ilaj kyun hota hai jabke viral ka aksar nahin?
blocks.explanation: Bacterial meningitis sab se shadeed aur jaan leva hai aur antibiotics bacteria par asar karti hain; viral aam taur par halki aur khud theek hone wali hai.

items: CNS infections taqreeban har jaraseem se. Meningitis: infection se meninges ki sozish; gardan akri, sar dard, bukhar; bacterial ke liye fauri antibiotics, kuch ke vaccines.
